display.purpose: The wordmark in the centre disc only.

headline.purpose: The three scroll statements; max 22ch, centred, balanced.

body.purpose: Tagline (max 24ch); language line and footer use nearby sizes.

script-devanagari.purpose: Applied via :lang(hi), falling back to Anek Latin.

script-gurmukhi.purpose: Applied via :lang(pa), falling back to Anek Latin.

shadows.name: ring-glow
shadows.value: 0 0 calc(var(--band) * 0.55vmin) color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 38%, transparent), inset 0 0 calc(var(--band) * 0.45vmin) color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 30%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Every ring band, tinted by its own hue.

shadows.name: action-lift
shadows.purpose: Primary action at rest, floating over the rings.

shadows.name: action-lift-hover
shadows.purpose: Primary action on hover, with a 2px rise.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Primary action hover lift, 220ms; dropped under reduced motion.

motion.name: story-track
motion.purpose: Scroll-scrubbed flight; progress p in 0..1 drives every stage property per animation frame.

motion.name: ring-flight
motion.value: scale = exp(ramp(p, 0.02, 0.32) * (1.85 + 0.28 * i)) for rings 2-5; disc exp(fly * 1.75)
motion.purpose: Exponential per-ring scale; outer rings open faster, reading as a tunnel at constant speed.

motion.name: violet-cap
motion.value: min(exp(fly * 2.13), 0.9 * cornerDistance / ((r0 + gap) * vmin)); opacity 1 -> 0.7 over p 0.20-0.30
motion.purpose: The inner ring stops short of the frame corners and frames the statements.

motion.name: violet-names-exit
motion.purpose: Ring 1's name layer leaves before the rim settles, so no name pill is cut by the frame edge; the violet band keeps --ring1-o.

motion.name: fades
motion.value: disc out p 0.08-0.20; outer rings out p 0.24-0.34; hero out and to 1.35x over p 0.02-0.12
motion.purpose: Clears the stage for the statements.

motion.name: beat-reveal
motion.value: windows [0.22,0.30,0.46,0.53] [0.53,0.61,0.72,0.79] [0.79,0.87,stay]; enter ease 1-2^(-10t) from +2.5rem and 10px blur; leave -2rem with 6px blur
motion.purpose: Statements rise inside the violet ring in turn.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce or no JS -> stacked static sections
motion.purpose: Same content without the scrubbed stage; no autonomous animation anywhere.

breakpoints.name: portrait
breakpoints.purpose: Scheme pills switch to their portrait angle set.

narrative.overview:
Janmitra's world is a black ground holding five concentric rings of saturated colour, one ring per scheme category, each carrying the real schemes it contains. The rings are the content, not decoration: the published catalogue drawn as a target the visitor can see whole in one viewport and then enter. A dark centre disc holds the wordmark; everything else is white type set heavy in Anek Latin, an Indian multi-script superfamily, so Latin, Devanagari and Gurmukhi share one voice.

Depth comes from flight, not from stacked surfaces. A scroll-scrubbed stage flies the viewer into the rings, outer rings opening faster as in a tunnel, until the dark centre fills the screen and three short statements rise inside it one at a time. The page then releases into an embedded phone that actually places the call. Density is low and type is large, honouring readers with low literacy and low-end phones.

The landing world and the call screen are two systems on one page. The call screen is an embedded device surface: a deliberate iOS in-call imitation with its own native tokens, which the landing world frames but never restyles.
keyCharacteristics: Black ground, five saturated ring hues, white heavy type.
Each ring is a scheme category; its schemes ride it as dark pills.
One signature motion: scroll-scrubbed flight into the rings; nothing moves on its own.
Pills everywhere a shape is needed; circles for the rings and disc; no rectangles with corners.
Without JavaScript or with reduced motion, the same content reads as plain stacked sections.

rules.name: The Ring Order Rule
rules.body: The five hues always appear in the same order, inner to outer: violet, blue, green, saffron, rose. A hue names its category; do not reassign it.

rules.name: The Borrowed Accent Rule
rules.body: Accents in type are borrowed from the rings, never introduced. A statement's key phrase takes one ring hue; selection and focus take saffron.

rules.name: The Own Script Rule
rules.body: Text in Hindi or Punjabi carries its `lang` attribute and renders in Anek's own Devanagari or Gurmukhi cut, so every language shares one family. Language names inside a sentence step up to white at 650.

rules.name: The Names-Above-Bands Rule
rules.body: Scheme names never share a stacking layer with ring bands. Bands render first, then the disc, then every ring's names, so a name that spills past its own band is never covered by an outer band. A new ring or name goes into the matching layer, never inside its band's element.

rules.name: The Solved Angle Rule
rules.body: A new scheme name gets an angle solved against its measured size and the 12px clearances above, in both orientations. Never space names evenly by count, and never rely on the hide script as the placement method; it is a safety net.

rules.name: The Self-Lit Ring Rule
rules.body: A ring glows only in its own colour. No neutral glows, no glow on type.

dos: **Do** keep the five ring hues in their fixed order, inner violet to outer rose, one per scheme category.

**Do** put real scheme names on the rings, upright, at landscape and portrait angles solved for 12px clearance from each other, the wordmark and the action, and hide any that still clip or collide rather than nudging them.
**Do** set all landing type in Anek Latin at weights 500 to 800, with script text in Anek's Devanagari or Gurmukhi cut via `lang`.
**Do** tint secondary text toward the violet ring (Lavender Mist), and borrow accent colours only from the rings.
**Do** drive motion from scroll position, and give no-JS and reduced-motion visitors the same content as stacked sections.
**Do** keep the call device's iOS tokens inside the device; frame it from landing.css with only stage and `--u` overrides.
donts: **Don't** add autonomous ring spin, looping animation, or motion that runs without scroll.
**Don't** introduce grey secondary text or a sixth accent hue.
**Don't** use squared or slightly-rounded corners on the landing; shapes are circles and pills.
**Don't** bring the SF font stack or iOS colours out of the call device into the landing world.
**Don't** place more than one white solid action in a viewport; the white pill is the primary action.
